title: Computation of the Flat Monthly Benefit for a Month of Training
content:
**Award computation — the flat monthly benefit of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606, Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

**(1) Month paid.** The month paid is the month covered by the student's most recent verification on the benefit. When no verification is on file at all, the day of the call stands in for the first day of the month paid.

**(2) Certification used.** The student's resident term certification: the latest certification on the benefit, by term start, whose courses are not all distance learning.

**(3) Rate.** The flat monthly rate of the tier for the training time recorded on the resident term certification: the full-time rate for full time, the three-quarter-time rate for three-quarter time, the half-time rate for half time, and for less than half time the less-than-half-time rate, never more than the tuition and fees on the resident certification spread over its term at 30 days a month — that is, the tuition and fees multiplied by 30 and divided by the days of the term, both ends counted. The tier rates are those of the flat monthly rate table.

**(4) Days payable.** The days payable run from the first day of the month paid through the earliest of: its thirtieth day; the term end of the resident term certification; and the delimiting date on the benefit record. Each is taken as the day of the month on which it falls, counting the first day of the month as day 1, and both ends are counted. There are none when the delimiting date is before the month (or the term ended before it), and there is no delimiting limit when the benefit has no delimiting date.

**(5) Amount.** The rate under (3) multiplied by the days payable under (4) and divided by a 30-day month, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figures (hypothetical records, Chapter 30 rates of $2518.00 full time and $629.50 less than half time).**

| Records | Days payable | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Full time; month verified April; term ends in June; no delimiting date | 30 | $2518.00 |
| Full time; month verified April; term ends April 18 | 18 | 2518 times 18 divided by 30: $1510.80 |
| Full time; month verified April; delimiting date April 10 | 10 | 2518 times 10 divided by 30 is 839.333, rounded: $839.33 |
| Full time; month verified April; delimiting date March 20 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Less than half time; tuition and fees $900.00 over a 120-day term; whole month payable | 30 | Rate limited to 900 times 30 divided by 120, $225.00; amount $225.00 |
